headline: The supported Node range excludes Node 26 releases before 26.12.1, and the docs-site container runs Node 26.12.1.
summary: `engines.node` is now `>=24.22.1 <25 || >=26.12.1`. Node 24.22.1 and 26.12.1 fix CVE-2026-111497, an out-of-bounds write in the Brotli decoder Node bundles. The previous range, `>=24.22.1`, also admitted Node 25 and every Node 26 release before 26.12.1, none of which carry the fix. The Node 24 minimum is unchanged. On Node 25, or on Node 26 before 26.12.1, `npm` warns and installs while Yarn 1 and any `engine-strict` setting refuse, so upgrade Node. The narrowing lands inside the window the LTS calendar freezes a major's Node minimum for, and it ships as a patch; both are recorded in MIGRATING.md under "Exceptions taken". No verb, option, error code or on-disk layout changed.

Security: The docs-site container (`examples/wiki/Dockerfile`) pins a base image that runs Node 26.12.1. The previous pin ran Node 26.5.0, and a build of the Dockerfile with no build-args used it. If you deploy the docs site from that Dockerfile, rebuild it.
Added: `scripts/check-node-pins.js` checks every Node version pinned in the repository against `engines.node`: `.node-version`, `.nvmrc`, the CI, fuzzing, publish and release-container workflows, and `docker-compose.test.yml`. It also requires `examples/wiki/package.json` to declare the same range. It runs in `npm run gates` and `npm run smoke`. In CI, `--image` also runs the docs-site base image with `--version` and checks the result, since that image is pinned by digest.
